extends: evidence/issue-54-gbbq-decimal bounded 9-event matrix; same frozen candidate rules, now applied to every retained category=1 record and to all #53 four-security category=1 events without a first-N cap
input_scope: Retained official artifacts only: local gbbq member, local hsjday.zip, pinned community decoder source. No new download, no BaoStock query, no security reselection.

community_decoder_source.boundary: community reverse-engineering evidence, not official TDX contract

selection: Decode every retained record (count_u32_le = 205727); no sampling
Histogram scope: every decoded record with category == 1, regardless of code shape
Four-security matrix scope: every category=1 record of the #53 fixed securities sh.600004, sh.600006, sz.000002, sz.000004; no first-N cap; retain unresolved previous close rather than skip

candidates.rule: Decimal(repr(decoded float32 promoted to Python float)); existing frozen diagnostic input
Decimal.from_float(decoded float32 promoted exactly to float64)
For n=1..9 use Python format(value, .ng); select first decimal that struct.pack(<f, float(decimal)) maps back to original bits; no field or security exception
exact_binary.quantize(0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP), same scale on C1/C2/C3/C4
exact_binary.quantize(0.001, ROUND_HALF_UP), same scale on C1/C2/C3/C4
exact_binary.quantize(0.0001, ROUND_HALF_UP), same scale on C1/C2/C3/C4
exact_binary.quantize(0.000001, ROUND_HALF_UP), same scale on C1/C2/C3/C4

histograms.category_counts: decoded category byte -> count over all 205727 records
histograms.per_field: for each C1..C4 over all category=1 records: zero/nonzero/negative/non_finite counts, distinct raw-bits count, tail count (exact binary decimal != shortest float32 roundtrip decimal), full distinct-value list sorted by raw bits hex with count, repr diagnostic and shortest decimal
histograms.field_combination_patterns: 4-bit nonzero mask (C1,C2,C3,C4) -> count over all category=1 records
histograms.symbol_coverage: (market,code) -> category=1 record count, first and last date_iso

calculation.reference_rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.01 (frozen research rule, not official semantics)
calculation.single_event_ratio_diagnostic: ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.000001; not a replacement for a full cumulative factor chain
calculation.day_observed: previous trading bar and event-date bar from the retained official .day member are recorded raw; previous_close is the close integer/100
calculation.unknown_policy: Unresolved previous close remains explicit; cannot support a production conclusion

cross_checks: gbbq member sha256/byte count/count header must match the pinned retained member
decoder source sha256 and git blob sha1 must match the pinned community source
hsjday.zip sha256 and the four .day member sha256 must match #53 selection.json
freshly decoded category=1 events of the four securities must equal committed selected-events.json entries (record_index and clear_hex)
category=1 records with six-digit numeric code must total the committed 68642
decoded category set must equal the committed structure-summary category list
acceptance: Only independently auditable official business field/normalization/rounding evidence can establish a production contract. Full-domain histograms, matrix compatibility, shortest roundtrip or any fitted decimal alone is insufficient.
full_four_stock_revalidation: Only if a normalization contract is established; otherwise NOT_RUN and #53 aggregate remains CROSS_MARKET_VALIDATION_HAS_MISMATCH
